We can see how much it has been lifted by observing the shift in the position of moles. Typically, 4-5 cm of SMAS is excised during a Deep Plane Facelift, which means that the sagging of the face and neck is improved by that amount. In more severe cases, the lift can be even greater, with more than 10 cm being excised. What should be noted here is 'the Beautiful Ear Shape' and 'the Nearly Invisible Incision Line'. It is important that the Tragus has a three-dimensional appearance and the Ear Lobe is rounded. Additionally, the incision around the ear doesn’t show signs of surgery, which speaks to the high level of sophistication and elegance in the surgical result. These are the aspects visible in this single photo, and the key factor is 'Releasing All Retaining Ligaments in the Sub-SMAS Plane.' This is the core of the Deep Plane Facelift, which not only contributes to the excellent results but also makes the incision lines almost invisible. Dfk1ZYFG-k2.text: drmarceloolivan Instituto Olivan Follow drmarceloolivan 2w O Microlift é, sim, um lifting realizado no Deep Plane. A área anatômica tratada é a mesma: o plano profundo da face, com reposicionamento das estruturas responsáveis pela sustentação facial. O diferencial do Microlift Deep Plane está principalmente na forma de acesso. A abordagem foi desenvolvida para realizar esse tratamento profundo com incisões menores e estrategicamente posicionadas, buscando manter as cicatrizes em regiões mais discretas. Por isso, o termo “micro” não se refere à profundidade da cirurgia. O procedimento continua sendo realizado no Deep Plane. Neste carrossel, explico de forma objetiva o que muda entre uma abordagem convencional do Deep Plane Facelift e o Microlift. Tem alguma dúvida sobre Microlift Deep Plane ou lifting facial?
